source_message: MISSÃO: MIGRAÇÃO CONTROLADA DE UMA EDIÇÃO DA AGES. Edição-alvo: AGES II. Execute somente a edição indicada, utilizando o harness previamente aprovado.
presentation_prerequisite: The user approved the AGES I presentation pattern for reuse; see migration/approvals/ages-i-presentation-accepted.json and docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md.

technology_reference_convention.basis: The user authorized choosing access dates inside each AGES period and instructed that the access year be used as the publication year, following Mariah's convention.
technology_reference_convention.historical_access_warning: The assigned access date is a user-approved bibliographic convention and is not recovered browser history or proof that the page was visited on that exact date.
technology_reference_convention.versions_used_in_project: Do not infer or claim versions without source evidence.

missing_material.action: Insert the approved visibly provisional placeholder; do not invent diagram content or source.
Keep provenance pending for the seven embedded original images until the user identifies each source.

constraints: Do not convert any unit outside this chapter.
Preserve the source text, order, punctuation, anchors, URLs and original media bytes.
Do not revise Portuguese, add facts, or fill missing content by inference.
Use the approved visual rules in docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md.
Stop after AGES II delivery and await human approval; do not begin AGES III, AGES IV or the Hoortech client participation.
